craft_notes: Sthāyin: minute-reality (inverse of v53: not left but manifested). Rows: row 3 (meditated→manifested). Close: manifested (vyajyate — the positive twin of v53's burnt). Rejected: 'atoms' — killed: minute-minuter things kept; 'cosmos' — killed: world's or even kept.

lines: In own body, world's or minute-minuter things and
realities' abiding at end — the supreme manifested.
l4.sanskrit_cite: svadehe jagato vāpi sūkṣmasūkṣmatarāṇi ca | tattvāni yāni nilayaṃ dhyātvānte vyajyate parā

reads_against.argmap: Where is the supreme manifested? → Meditating the minutest realities in own body manifests the supreme.
c1_essence: Minutest realities in own body: the supreme is manifested.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta undertow (stillness with the burnt-world wonder)
